visualizerParams.title: Guided Practice: Visible Keyboard Focus
visualizerParams.description: Type a style for the focused input so keyboard users can see where they are. The :focus rule changes the border colour while the field is active.
visualizerParams.ghostCode:
<style>
  input { outline: none; border: 2px solid gray; }
  input:focus { border-color: blue; }
</style>
<input id="name" placeholder="Your name">

checks.label: The field has a gray border at rest
A :focus rule turns the border blue
